dependency_gap_note: Three of the six formal dependencies (progression_framework, ability_framework, skill_framework) do not exist yet at time of writing, per the requested build order. This is handled architecturally rather than papered over: PersistentStateRegistry below is designed as an OPEN, extensible registration contract — each framework registers its own state slots when it is built, rather than SaveFramework hardcoding their shapes in advance. This is good save-system design regardless of build order, not a workaround. registered_frameworks below will be updated as progression_framework, ability_framework, and skill_framework are each built next.
scope_compliance_statement: This file defines the contract for what gets persisted and how, never the specific save file format, compression, or platform storage mechanism. It contains no economy or currency data, consistent with GameplayRules.json Scope Enforcement Rule SR-04.

contract.registration_method: Any framework may register a named state slot here by declaring: slot_id, owning_framework, data_shape_description, persistence_priority.

registered_slots.data_shape_description: Character registry entity list and non-corporeal flags, per CharacterFramework.json character_registry.
Selected identity slot (PLYR_identity_kaevon or PLYR_identity_veronica), persisted at selection time per PlayerFramework.json identity_selection.contract.
Which interactable_ids have been resolved, to prevent re-triggering one-time interactions across a save/load cycle.

upstream_tracked_state.note: The six tracked state variables already exist upstream in the locked Meridian_Master package. This registry references them by name; it does not redefine or duplicate their shape.
upstream_tracked_state.persistence_priority: highest — these gate ending-state logic in the locked campaign

contract.versioning_policy: schema_version must match the current package_version of this Gameplay_Master package at write time. A load-time version mismatch triggers a migration hook, not a silent data reinterpretation.
contract.content_policy: This contract defines slot structure only — no specific save file format (binary, JSON, etc.) is mandated here.

This is a fire-and-forget request contract. It does not define which specific gameplay moments call it — a future Missions package decides checkpoint placement, this framework only guarantees the hook exists.

state_category_mapping.added_during: Phase 2 audit — the new brief names these categories explicitly by name; mapping them prevents ambiguity about ownership.

mission_state.owner: UNDEFINED — no Missions package exists yet
mission_state.registered_slot: not registered — out of scope for this package

narrative_state.owner: the six tracked state variables, upstream in locked Meridian_Master

npc_state.owner: UNDEFINED — no AI package exists yet
npc_state.registered_slot: not registered — out of scope for this package

persistent_consequences.owner: expressed through the six tracked state variables

important_relationships.owner: expressed through nyx_status and Undercroft reputation (Gameplay_Design_Master.md Section 9)
